limits.name: 30 characters. Indexed by search — put your strongest term in it.
limits.subtitle: 30 characters. Also indexed. Do not repeat words already in the name.
limits.keywords: 100 characters TOTAL, comma-separated. The single most wasted field on the App Store.
limits.promotionalText: 170 characters. Not indexed, but editable without a new build.
limits.description: 4000 characters. Not indexed by search; write it for the human who is already reading.
limits.whatsNew: 4000 characters. Required on every version after 1.0.

keywordRules: No space after commas. "a,b,c" not "a, b, c" — every space burns one of your 100 characters.
Never repeat a word that is already in the name or subtitle. Those are indexed already; repeating them buys nothing and costs slots.
workflow: ship aso harvest   — pull real competitor terms for your markets
ship aso score     — rank them by traffic vs difficulty
ship aso pack      — fill these 100 characters optimally
ship meta lint     — offline validation before anything touches ASC
ship meta apply    — push this listing to App Store Connect
notes.delete: This notes block is ignored by every ship command. Delete it once the listing is written.
